habitat: An active, restless bird of open woodland. Pairs work through the mid stratum and call continuously.
summary: A fairly common resident. A small pied bird with rich rufous flanks in both sexes and a black and white wing-bar. The female is dark brown above and has a brown cap. The immature is similar but has a streaked breast. The male gives a drawn-out whistle, trrioooo, and the female answers with a softer wheezy wheee. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

calls.description: The male gives a drawn-out, far-carrying whistle, trrioooo, like a telephone. The female replies with a softer, wheezy wheee. Grade A call from Faan Meintjes Nature Reserve near Klerksdorp. The filename is XC441144-Brubru FM 3.1.2018.mp3.

research.note: Newman calls it a fairly common resident, so status is resident and all twelve months are listed. White underparts are described in the pattern rather than split into breast and belly tokens. Population figures and the Kemp code RB were left unchanged.
